alex_cs: escalating from SOC ticket — customer hit a parsing failure when calling our API with response_format=json and strict=true. They get a 200 but SDK fails to parse "Invalid JSON". alex_cs: repro steps they gave (trimmed): ``` curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/outputs \ -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \ -H 'Accept: application/json' \ -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ -d '{"model":"gpt-xl-1","input":"summarize: ...","response_format":"json","strict":true}' ``` alex_cs: body they received (raw): ```

Upstream error

502 Bad Gateway

``` maria_support: do we have the request id or our proxied headers? if Content-Type is text/html then strict mode will reject even if status 200. can customer paste response headers? alex_cs: they pasted headers: `content-type: text/html; charset=utf-8`, `x-request-id: rwd-8f7e2b`, `x-backend: model-prod-3` — server returned 200 though body is html (weird). ingrid_eng: that looks like an upstream model host returned an error page but our proxy didn't map it to 502. likely path: model host returns HTML on internal failure; our response mapper kept 200. strict JSON enforcement then fails client-side. ingrid_eng: quick triage steps: check routing logs for rwd-8f7e2b, confirm if model-prod-3 had a rollout/oom around that time, and inspect transform layer that sets status/content-type. tom_infra: seeing increased latency spikes for model-prod-3 around that window. I can pull the proxy logs and health checks. might be autoscaler flapping -> returns html from nginx upstream. maria_support: customer also said this started after they enabled strict mode; previously they had tolerant parsing. they switched to strict to enforce schema but now failing. alex_cs: customer wants: 1) root cause, 2) short-term workaround so their service doesn't crash, 3) prevention. Marking P1 for support SLA. ingrid_eng: short-term workaround options: 1) instruct customer to remove strict=true (or strict false) or 2) accept non-200 from our side and treat html as an error and surface structured error {"error":"upstream_html","detail":"..."} with Content-Type: application/json. We should prefer serving a structured error so SDKs can handle. tom_infra: I can patch the gateway to normalize upstream HTML errors to 502 + JSON body for a hotfix behind a flag. will need a quick release (10–15m) and rollback plan. qa_bot: automated replay of customer request against staging shows same HTML when we force a model timeout. Repro confirmed. maria_support: please confirm if this is tied to auth/billing — customer also reported an earlier 402 from billing; could be token rotation or billing throttle falling back to a portal html page. alex_cs: checked logs — no 402 for this request id. billing events earlier in their account but not this call. Billing not root cause here. ingrid_eng: also seeing a case of schema drift: recently we changed a variant to return `metadata` as null sometimes; customer strict schema expected object -> parser raised field type error in some runs. separate than HTML issue but both surface as "Invalid JSON" to clients. we need two paths: fix gateway HTML mapping and add schema-regression monitoring. maria_support: proposed immediate action list: - tom_infra: deploy gateway normalization patch behind flag + enable for rwd-8f7e2b region (now) - ingrid_eng: add temporary tolerant error wrapper for strict mode that returns structured error with code `UPSTREAM_NOT_JSON` instead of raw html (hotfix) - alex_cs: send customer canned workaround: remove strict or add client-side try/catch + fallback to non-strict for 24h tom_infra: starting patch now, will post deploy-bot updates. qa_bot: regression test matrix updated: simulate model host returning text/html and assert gateway returns 502 + application/json body for strict enforcement endpoints. ingrid_eng: longer term: add a check in model onboarding that upstream never returns html for any valid inference path; add alert when content-type != application/json and status==200. Also add schema drift monitors against golden prompt sets. alex_cs: customer notified of mitigation steps and will try temporary workaround. keeping thread open until gateway patch and monitoring in place. maria_support: if we can't ship patch fast, we should provide the customer a signed proxy rule they can enable that sets Accept header to `application/vnd.redwood.structured+json` (internal feature) to force structured errors. but prefer we fix server side. ingrid_eng: noted. will follow up with postmortem once logs compiled. thanks all. :pray: alex_cs: assigning to ingrid/tom. closing after hotfix verification and customer confirmation.
